value.rationale: The parameter-dependent nullspace and exact sharp nonzero unit-activity condition number answer the natural complete Fourier recovery problem for a widely used random-forest root distribution. The resonance at t=n annihilates all character shells of weight at least two; at unit activity invertibility alternates exactly by graph parity. This is a complete, motivated infinite-family classification, rather than an arbitrary small finite slice. The result is elementary once the classical root set enumerator is accepted, and does not address general graphs.
